notes: Model-specific forced-alignment calibration profile (ADR 0027) for the Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B-8bit engine executed through the Model runtime subprocess (ADR 0055) with mlx-audio. model_identity binds the exact pinned model asset SHA-256, the mlx-audio backend and version, the 8-bit precision, the apple-m1 device class, and the alignment rules fingerprint; any bound-identity change invalidates the profile for adoption. window.window_pad_samples is the symmetric audio breathing room (0.5 s at 16 kHz) added around each Primary cue's original subtitle interval before the aligner refines its boundaries within the containing VAD chunk. thresholds.minimum_confidence gates candidate adoption in the existing Adopted alignment timing view (ADR 0027): Qwen3-ForcedAligner performs a single non-autoregressive forward pass emitting decided word/char timestamps with no soft score, so a placed cue carries confidence 1.0 (not a soft probability) and the threshold reserves the confidence gate for any future soft-scoring aligner while keeping ADR 0027's meaning; the operative adoption gate for this engine is the language-aware duration-plausibility rule plus the usable-audio-coverage and VAD-conflict checks. thresholds.duration_rules are the versioned, language-aware minimum/maximum cue durations (ADR 0027 forbids a global character/word-count substitute); the en/zh baselines are 0.3 s minimum and 10 s maximum. qualification_scope is 'first_device_baseline': these settings qualify formal adopted timing only for synthetic verification here, and the Chinese/English alignment quality of the selection is confirmed only by the maintainer sample review in the Phase 11 prototype ticket, not by this record.
